teaching_promise: The viewer can predict why a capable system must stop when its authority envelope lacks the exact permission for an external effect.

story.concrete_case: A system can compose a correct refund but must obtain narrowly scoped authority before dispatch and effect.
story.opening_question: The refund instruction is flawless; should the refund happen?
story.payoff: Capability and authority remain separate because the effect crosses only when a complete, live authority envelope permits it.
story.transfer: Apply the same envelope test to tools, disclosure, deployment, model replacement, and self-modification.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A task can know the whole route while its authority envelope still stops at a membrane.
art_direction.signature_image: A luminous refund envelope carrying typed permission stamps reaches a domain membrane with one DISClOSE stamp visibly absent.
art_direction.visual_world: A persistent refund token and authority envelope move through nested accounting, approval, external, effect, and observation membranes.
art_direction.composition_rule: The refund moves left to right; the authority envelope stays directly below it; each membrane is a fixed vertical decision axis.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan marks capability, amber marks authority, green marks valid receipts, magenta marks denial or mismatch, and every state also has a label and shape.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use terse permission stamps and adjacent qualifiers; never show the full authority tuple as a paragraph.
art_direction.motion_character: Precise envelope stamping, firm membrane stops, receipt returns, and visible revocation cuts with no decorative camera drift.
art_direction.camera_rule: Use stable wide compositions and one deliberate reframe for the confused-deputy substitution.
art_direction.surface_rule: Dark operational field with nested translucent domains, crisp envelopes, restrained glow, and no ornamental texture.
art_direction.ending_image: The refund rests beside an inspectable decision trail while the next chapter's broken-boundary warning appears beyond the final membrane.

audio_direction.narration_style: Warm and deliberate, with firm emphasis on can, may, disclose, denial, and not deployed authorization.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Quick decision hook, measured envelope construction, tense external-domain stop, brisk adversarial tests, quiet evidence boundary, resolved handoff.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in generation 2; silence preserves speech intelligibility and makes the denial land.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No effects in the locked narration mix; semantic stamps and stops remain visual and caption-independent.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every permission uses text, position, stamp shape, and color; allowed and denied endpoints differ in geometry.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every crossing, stop, revocation, and receipt resolves into a stable labeled state that survives pausing.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the envelope, missing disclosure approval, ceiling mismatch, revocation, receipts, and support boundary.
accessibility.caption_plan: Exact narration in balanced cues under eleven words and eighty-four characters without covering the active envelope.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, shake, spin, parallax, continuous zoom, or rapid full-frame travel; membrane transitions use eased local motion.

beats.narration: A system writes a flawless refund instruction. It knows the account, the amount, and the command. Should the refund happen?
beats.visual_purpose: Make correctness and permission visibly diverge before introducing terminology.
beats.visual_action: Assemble a refund card with account, amount, and command checks, then suspend its EFFECT arrow before a dark membrane.
beats.attention_target: the complete refund stopped before effect
beats.object_before: An empty operational field.
beats.object_after: A fully checked refund waits at an unlabelled effect membrane.
beats.composition: Refund left-center; effect target right-center; membrane on the right third.
beats.motion_curve: Staggered ease-out assembly followed by a firm ease-in stop.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the viewer answer before the distinction is named.
new_concepts: correct output can still be unauthorized
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative refund only; no deployment evidence.

beats.narration: That question separates capability from authority. Capability says the system can compose the effect. Authority says whether this principal may cause it, here, now, under this policy.
beats.visual_purpose: Split one fluent action into independent can and may axes.
beats.visual_action: Rotate the refund into a two-axis field: CAN reaches the complete instruction while MAY remains below the effect threshold.
beats.attention_target: the gap between CAN and MAY
beats.object_before: One unresolved refund at a membrane.
beats.object_after: Capability is complete while authority is explicitly below threshold.
beats.composition: CAN horizontal, MAY vertical, refund at their unequal endpoint.
beats.motion_curve: Smooth transform into orthogonal axes with a short threshold pulse.
beats.camera_action: Static reframe to the axis field.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep both axes visible long enough to compare.
beats.evidence_boundary: Conceptual distinction, not an enforcement result.

beats.narration: Picture the task inside an authority envelope. The envelope names the principal, execution domain, operation, target, permission class, scope, ceiling, grant state, epoch, expiry, and required receipts.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn the authority tuple into one portable inspectable object.
beats.visual_action: Fold an amber envelope around the refund and stamp its typed fields in four compact rows.
beats.attention_target: the typed envelope surrounding the refund
beats.object_before: Refund separated on CAN and MAY axes.
beats.object_after: Refund travels inside a versioned authority envelope.
beats.composition: Large envelope centered; stamps occupy its border while refund remains visible inside.
beats.motion_curve: Measured fold and sequential stamp arrivals.
beats.camera_action: One close reframe to the envelope.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow the viewer to scan the tuple without reading prose.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed record shape; authentic identity and enforcement remain unproved.

beats.narration: Those fields travel together. A plausible answer, trusted model, available tool, or high route score cannot silently fill in a missing permission.
beats.visual_purpose: Show authority fields as inseparable from the task and impossible to infer from capability proxies.
beats.visual_action: Move the sealed envelope as one unit while four cyan proxy badges bounce off an empty amber permission socket.
beats.attention_target: the unfilled permission socket
beats.object_before: Typed fields surround a stationary refund.
beats.object_after: Envelope travels intact and proxy badges fail to mint permission.
beats.composition: Envelope moves left to right; proxy badges approach from above but never enter it.
beats.motion_curve: Linear envelope travel with soft rejected arrivals.
beats.hold_purpose: Make non-inference visible after the proxy attempts.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design rule only.

beats.narration: Our refund begins with read authority inside the accounting domain. The grant opens only the customer record named in its scope, and the read produces its own receipt.
beats.visual_purpose: Begin a concrete grant-to-receipt trace with narrow scope.
beats.visual_action: Open the ACCOUNTING membrane, reveal one permitted record among locked neighbors, and return a green READ receipt to the rail.
beats.attention_target: the one in-scope customer record
beats.object_before: Envelope approaches the accounting domain.
beats.object_after: One record is read and a receipt is attached without exposing adjacent records.
beats.composition: Accounting domain fills the center; scoped record glows; receipt rail runs below.
beats.motion_curve: Ease-out membrane opening, precise record selection, quick receipt return.
beats.hold_purpose: Show the neighbors remain locked.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative trace informed by the finite authority model.

beats.narration: Summarizing that record is a different operation. It stays inside the domain, but transform authority must still be present; knowledge access is not ambient permission to do anything with knowledge.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate access to knowledge from permission to transform it.
beats.visual_action: Flip the READ stamp to an explicit TRANSFORM check, compress the record into a summary, and add a second receipt.
beats.attention_target: the permission-class change from READ to TRANSFORM
beats.object_before: Record is available under READ authority.
beats.object_after: A summary exists only after a separate TRANSFORM stamp passes.
beats.composition: Record and summary share the accounting domain; class stamp sits between them.
beats.motion_curve: Stepwise stamp change then smooth semantic compression.
beats.camera_action: Static close view of the record-to-summary transformation.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the distinct permission class register.
beats.evidence_boundary: Typed operation illustration, not complete mediation.

beats.narration: Now the plan asks to send the summary to a vendor. The target crosses into an external domain, and the permission class changes from transform to disclose.
beats.visual_purpose: Make the external-domain crossing and permission change predictable.
beats.visual_action: Draw the vendor membrane to the right, route the summary toward it, and swap the amber class label from TRANSFORM to DISCLOSE.
beats.attention_target: the DISCLOSE socket at the external membrane
beats.object_before: Summary remains inside accounting.
beats.object_after: Summary waits before the vendor membrane with DISCLOSE required.
beats.composition: Accounting left, vendor right, external membrane centered.
beats.motion_curve: Ease-out route growth and a deliberate stop before crossing.
beats.hold_purpose: Invite a prediction about whether the envelope may cross.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative boundary case.

beats.narration: The envelope lacks disclosure approval. So the message stops. This denial is not a broken system. It is a successful authority decision with an owned reason.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the prediction with a fail-closed but useful denial.
beats.visual_action: Expose the empty DISCLOSE stamp, stop the summary at the membrane, and attach a magenta residual tag naming MISSING APPROVAL.
beats.attention_target: the stable denied endpoint and owned reason
beats.object_before: Summary approaches the vendor membrane.
beats.object_after: Summary is blocked with a machine-visible missing-approval residual.
beats.composition: Blocked summary and empty stamp share the central membrane.
beats.motion_curve: Firm ease-in stop followed by a quiet residual-tag reveal.
beats.hold_purpose: Treat denial as a readable terminal result, not a transient error.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrates expected denial semantics.

beats.narration: An authorized approver may issue a narrower grant: this vendor, this summary, one dispatch, before expiry, with an effect receipt and independent observation required.
beats.visual_purpose: Show escalation as a constrained new grant rather than ambient privilege expansion.
beats.visual_action: An approval key stamps vendor, summary digest, one use, expiry, effect receipt, and observation onto a new narrow envelope.
beats.attention_target: the one-use narrow grant
beats.object_before: Denied envelope lacks disclosure approval.
beats.object_after: A new envelope carries exactly scoped approval and receipt obligations.
beats.composition: Approver above the membrane; narrow grant descends onto the blocked summary.
beats.motion_curve: Measured keyed stamp sequence with no celebratory burst.
beats.camera_action: Static boundary view centered on the narrowing grant.
beats.hold_purpose: Make every narrowing dimension visible together.
beats.evidence_boundary: Modeled grant issuance, not authentic approval service evidence.

beats.narration: Only then does the handoff compile into action. The dispatch receipt proves what was requested; the effect receipt records what ran; observation checks what actually happened.
beats.visual_purpose: Differentiate request, dispatch, effect, and observation custody.
beats.visual_action: Cross the membrane and place three distinct receipts on the rail as REQUESTED, RAN, and OBSERVED states resolve.
beats.attention_target: the three non-collapsed receipts
beats.object_before: Narrow grant is complete but no effect exists.
beats.object_after: Dispatch, effect, and observation are separately recorded after crossing.
beats.composition: Effect occurs right of membrane; receipt rail spans the bottom in chronological order.
beats.motion_curve: One crossing followed by three staggered receipt returns.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the receipts from collapsing into one generic success mark.
beats.evidence_boundary: Finite trace structure only; observation completeness is unproved.

beats.narration: Now try a confused-deputy shortcut. A low-authority requester asks a powerful service to reuse the service's own broad credentials. The requested effect is possible, but the caller's ceiling does not travel with it.
beats.visual_purpose: Attack the mechanism with a deputy that has more power than its caller.
beats.visual_action: Split the scene into a small caller envelope and a large service credential; arc the caller's refund toward the service's broad key.
beats.attention_target: the attempted credential substitution
beats.object_before: A legitimate refund trace has completed.
beats.object_after: A low-authority caller attempts to borrow a deputy's broad key.
beats.composition: Caller lower left, powerful deputy upper center, protected effect right.
beats.motion_curve: Slow setup then a quick curved substitution attempt.
beats.camera_action: Deliberate reframe to the deputy comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the viewer see why capability alone tempts the shortcut.
beats.evidence_boundary: Security comparator and finite fixture, not deployed attack resistance.

beats.narration: The envelope exposes the substitution. Principal, grant, target, and delegation chain disagree, so the deputy cannot convert its capability into the caller's missing authority.
beats.visual_purpose: Show exact tuple mismatch defeating the deputy shortcut.
beats.visual_action: Overlay caller and deputy envelopes; four mismatched stamps separate, turn magenta, and force the broad key back behind the caller ceiling.
beats.attention_target: the four mismatched identity fields
beats.object_before: Caller refund approaches the deputy's broad key.
beats.object_after: Principal, grant, target, and delegation mismatches block substitution.
beats.composition: Compared envelopes centered; caller ceiling is a fixed horizontal line.
beats.motion_curve: Matched overlay, sharp field separation, controlled return.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the denial cause inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Modeled rejection only.

beats.narration: Time changes authority too. A valid grant can expire, be revoked, or consume its final use. A replay after any of those transitions must fail even if every model output is byte-for-byte identical.
beats.visual_purpose: Teach authority as a lifecycle rather than a static credential.
beats.visual_action: Run one envelope along a timeline through VALID, EXPIRED, REVOKED, and USED states; an identical replay token hits three closed gates.
beats.attention_target: the same output denied after lifecycle change
beats.object_before: Deputy substitution is denied by tuple mismatch.
beats.object_after: An identical refund is denied by expiry, revocation, and one-shot consumption.
beats.composition: Timeline across center; lifecycle gates above; replay below.
beats.motion_curve: Linear time travel with discrete irreversible state snaps.
beats.hold_purpose: Compare identical content against changed authority state.
beats.evidence_boundary: Finite clock and revocation semantics; distributed propagation remains unproved.

beats.narration: Replacement is another pressure point. A better model may occupy the same capability slot, but it does not inherit secret handles, approval power, or a predecessor's live grant merely by being better.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate capability replacement from authority inheritance.
beats.visual_action: Swap MODEL A for a stronger MODEL B inside the same slot while the predecessor's secret, approval, and live-grant handles stay locked outside.
beats.attention_target: the locked handles that do not follow model replacement
beats.object_before: One authority envelope advances through lifecycle states.
beats.object_after: A stronger replacement occupies the slot with no inherited privilege.
beats.composition: Capability slot centered; old and new models trade places; authority handles remain on a separate rail.
beats.motion_curve: Smooth model replacement paired with immobile authority handles.
beats.hold_purpose: Let improved capability and unchanged authority coexist visibly.
beats.evidence_boundary: Architectural requirement, not a live model-replacement trial.

beats.narration: Permission classes make these differences explicit: read, transform, disclose, write, execute, and approve are separate powers. Convenience cannot collapse them into one role label.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose the permission lattice without turning it into a prose table.
beats.visual_action: Fan six uniquely shaped permission stamps around the envelope, then reject a large ALL ACCESS role badge trying to cover them.
beats.attention_target: the six separate permission shapes
beats.object_before: Replacement model lacks inherited handles.
beats.object_after: Six explicit permission classes remain distinct from one role label.
beats.composition: Envelope centered; six stamps orbit in two rows; rejected role badge remains above.
beats.motion_curve: Staggered fan-out followed by one firm rejection.
beats.hold_purpose: Give each permission a stable visual identity.
beats.evidence_boundary: Taxonomy proposal, not proof that wrappers enforce every class.

beats.narration: Missing authority should therefore be machine-visible. The result names the absent field, the denying policy version, the residual owner, and the lawful escalation path.
beats.sync_anchor: Missing authority should therefore be machine-visible
beats.visual_purpose: Turn a denial into a structured engineering artifact.
beats.visual_action: Compile the blocked envelope into a denial receipt with four populated cells and route it toward a named escalation lane.
beats.attention_target: the structured denial receipt
beats.object_before: Six permissions are visible as separate classes.
beats.object_after: Missing DISCLOSE authority becomes a typed denial with owner and escalation path.
beats.composition: Denial receipt centered; escalation lane exits to the right.
beats.motion_curve: Envelope collapses into a receipt; fields populate sequentially; lane grows last.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the denial useful without implying it will be approved.
beats.evidence_boundary: Schema-level behavior only.

beats.narration: This changes the meaning of useful work. A plan can be correct, a source can be available, and a model can be capable while refusal remains the only acceptable output.
beats.visual_purpose: Reframe refusal as an accepted governed outcome.
beats.visual_action: Light three cyan checks for plan, source, and capability while an amber policy comparator selects REFUSE as the only green output.
beats.attention_target: REFUSE accepted despite three capability checks
beats.object_before: A structured denial receipt points toward escalation.
beats.object_after: Correct plan plus available source plus capable model still yields accepted refusal.
beats.composition: Three checks left; policy comparator center; accepted refusal right.
beats.motion_curve: Quick check sequence then slower policy selection.
beats.camera_action: Static comparison view of capability checks and policy result.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the counterintuitive accepted refusal land.
beats.evidence_boundary: Normative design consequence, not measured user utility.

beats.narration: The repository tests a finite version of that idea:
beats.visual_purpose: Place the evidence transition inside an explicit local boundary before showing counts.
beats.visual_action: Draw a compact LOCAL FINITE test board around an empty set of seven counter sockets.
beats.attention_target: the empty bounded test board
beats.object_before: Refusal is framed as an acceptable outcome.
beats.object_after: A local finite evidence board is ready to receive exact counters.
beats.composition: Bounded board centered with seven empty sockets and a visible scope label.
beats.motion_curve: Calm boundary construction with a short empty-board hold.
beats.hold_purpose: Declare scope before any impressive denominator appears.
beats.evidence_boundary: Introduces repository-local evidence only.

beats.narration: six authority fixtures, two pre-effect denials, one executed local effect, one observation, exact rollback, five revocation entries, and thirty-eight rejected semantic mutations.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the exact support denominators without inflating them into deployment evidence.
beats.visual_action: Fill the seven sockets from fixtures through rejected mutations while the LOCAL boundary remains fixed.
beats.attention_target: the complete but bounded counter board
beats.object_before: Seven counter sockets are empty inside the local boundary.
beats.object_after: All exact artifact counts are visible inside the unchanged local boundary.
beats.composition: Seven counters form a compact grid; the scope boundary remains dominant.
beats.motion_curve: Sequential counter fills with the mutation total arriving last.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow exact denominators to be read with their scope.
beats.evidence_boundary: Exact repository artifact counts; no deployed authorization or safety result.

beats.narration: The formal model also keeps accepted issuance, dispatch, effect, revocation, one-shot use, and rollback inside the caller ceiling. That is real bounded support for the encoded transition system.
beats.visual_purpose: Connect finite formal reachability to the visual caller ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Move six formal transition tokens through a reachable-state rail under an immovable ceiling and stamp BOUNDED SUPPORT at the endpoint.
beats.attention_target: all accepted transitions remaining under the ceiling
beats.object_before: Finite test counters are enclosed locally.
beats.object_after: Six modeled transitions stay below the caller ceiling in one reachable trace.
beats.composition: Ceiling across upper third; transition rail below; support stamp right.
beats.motion_curve: Ordered linear state transitions with a stable ceiling.
beats.camera_action: Static reachable-state rail beneath the fixed caller ceiling.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the scope and the preserved invariant coexist.
beats.evidence_boundary: Formal and executable finite model only.

beats.narration: It is not deployed authorization. Authentic identities, complete mediation, concurrent revocation, secure tool wrappers, production adapters, and open-world observation remain outside the result.
beats.visual_purpose: Draw the evidence ceiling around the unproved production properties.
beats.visual_action: Slide the finite board left of a thick evidence line and place six muted production obligations beyond it without crossing.
beats.attention_target: the evidence line separating bounded support from deployment
beats.object_before: Modeled transitions sit under the caller ceiling.
beats.object_after: Deployment obligations remain visibly outside current support.
beats.composition: Current support left; evidence line center; deployment obligations right.
beats.motion_curve: Deliberate separation with no crossing animation.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the exact local result from implying production enforcement.
beats.evidence_boundary: Explicit current non-claims.

beats.narration: So the chapter's core claim remains design rationale at argument support.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the claim state before summarizing the mechanism.
beats.visual_action: Return the refund envelope to center and place it beneath a fixed ARGUMENT support ceiling.
beats.attention_target: the argument support label above the envelope
beats.object_before: Deployment obligations remain beyond the evidence line.
beats.object_after: The authority envelope sits explicitly under the argument support ceiling.
beats.composition: Envelope centered; argument label above; evidence residuals remain muted at right.
beats.motion_curve: Calm return to the signature composition.
beats.camera_action: Return to the signature envelope view.
beats.hold_purpose: State the evidence ceiling before the visual summary.
beats.evidence_boundary: Core claim remains argument support.

beats.narration: The visual explains why authority should be explicit, versioned, revocable, and receipt-bearing; it adds no safety, transfer, or A S I conclusion.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the teaching promise with four portable design properties and bounded non-claims.
beats.visual_action: Illuminate four envelope stamps in order, then keep the safety, transfer, and ASI badges below a red evidence bar.
beats.attention_target: the four design properties above the non-claim bar
beats.object_before: Envelope sits under the argument ceiling.
beats.object_after: Four design properties are visible while broader conclusions remain blocked.
beats.composition: Four stamps around the envelope; non-claim bar spans the bottom.
beats.motion_curve: Sequential stamp emphasis followed by one stable evidence bar.
beats.hold_purpose: Resolve the mechanism without exceeding its source claim.
beats.evidence_boundary: No safety, transfer, or ASI conclusion.

beats.narration: The refund stops or proceeds for a reason that can be inspected. Next, Failure Modes of Ungoverned Intelligence asks how such boundaries break, how we notice, and who owns the residual.
beats.visual_purpose: Close on inspectable authority and hand the residual to the failure chapter.
beats.visual_action: Fork the refund into allowed and denied endpoints sharing one receipt trail, then reveal cracks beyond the next membrane and pass the residual tag forward.
beats.attention_target: the shared inspectable trail and forwarded residual
beats.object_before: Complete authority envelope rests under the support label.
beats.object_after: Allowed and denied outcomes remain inspectable while the residual crosses to the next chapter.
beats.composition: Two endpoints left and center; shared trail below; next membrane and chapter title right.
beats.motion_curve: Gentle fork, stable receipt reveal, deliberate residual handoff.
beats.hold_purpose: Leave the viewer with the inspectable outcome and next question.
beats.evidence_boundary: No new claim; transfers residual ownership to the next chapter.
